skill.name: p-video
skill.description: Generate short AI videos with Pruna P-Video and WAN models through the inference.sh CLI.
skill.summary: Create text-to-video and image-to-video jobs with Pruna and WAN models through inference.sh.
skill.author: inferen-sh

security_audit.summary: The skill legitimately uses the inference.sh CLI to run remote Pruna and WAN video jobs. I confirmed the executable infsh examples and one remote embedded image as real risks, while most backtick and documentation URL alerts are Markdown false positives. No prompt injection or deceptive instruction text was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: External video generation commands can send prompts and media references to inference.sh.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running infsh login, app list, or app run commands, and show the app ID, media URLs, resolution, and estimated cost when possible.

remediation.issue: Image and audio examples may lead users to process sensitive media with a remote service.
remediation.suggestion: Add a privacy note telling users to use only media they own and are allowed to send to inference.sh.

remediation.issue: Related skill examples use npx skills add commands that expand the installed skill surface.
remediation.suggestion: Convert related skill installation commands into links or require a separate confirmation before suggesting any additional skill installation.

content.value_statement: Creating short AI videos from prompts or source media can require model-specific CLI knowledge. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Pruna P-Video and WAN commands in inference.sh.
actual_capabilities: Runs documented infsh commands for Pruna P-Video text-to-video jobs.
Provides image-to-video examples using external image URLs.
Shows audio input fields for P-Video jobs.
Documents WAN-T2V and WAN-I2V app IDs and resolution options.
Lists related inference.sh video skills and documentation links.
limitations: Requires an installed and authenticated inference.sh CLI.
Outputs depend on remote Pruna and WAN service availability.
Generation may consume account credits or paid usage.
Example media URLs must be replaced with accessible user-owned assets.

use_cases.title: Create prompt-based video drafts
use_cases.description: Turn a short scene prompt into a generated video using Pruna P-Video or WAN-T2V.

use_cases.title: Animate approved source images
use_cases.description: Use WAN-I2V or P-Video to add simple motion to an existing image URL.

use_cases.title: Compare remote video models
use_cases.description: List Pruna apps and choose between P-Video, WAN-T2V, and WAN-I2V for a specific job.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner text video
prompt_templates.scenario: A user wants a simple first generation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-second 720p video of waves at sunset with Pruna P-Video. Ask before running the command.

prompt_templates.title: Image animation
prompt_templates.scenario: A user has a source image URL.
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate this image with subtle camera motion using the best Pruna or WAN image-to-video option: [image URL].

prompt_templates.title: Draft comparison
prompt_templates.scenario: A user wants fast iteration before a final render.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a low-cost draft video first, then prepare a higher quality version after I approve the result.

prompt_templates.title: Model selection workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: A user needs the model chosen from requirements.
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose the best Pruna video model for a 720p product clip from a still image and narration audio. Explain the tradeoffs before running anything.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a five-second 720p beach video from a text prompt.
output_examples.output: The assistant selects Pruna P-Video, confirms the prompt and resolution, then runs the remote generation through infsh after approval.

output_examples.input: A user provides an image URL and asks for gentle motion.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends WAN-I2V or P-Video, checks that the image can be shared with inference.sh, and starts the image-to-video job.

output_examples.input: A user wants to explore available Pruna video apps.
output_examples.output: The assistant lists the Pruna namespace through infsh and summarizes the relevant video models and resolution choices.

best_practices: Confirm the model, prompt, media URLs, and resolution before running infsh commands.
Use draft mode for quick concept checks before higher quality renders.
Use only media that the user owns or has permission to process remotely.
anti_patterns: Do not run remote generation without user approval.
Do not send private audio, images, or unreleased campaign material without consent.
Do not assume 1080p is needed when 720p or draft mode is sufficient.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It helps generate short AI videos through Pruna P-Video, WAN-T2V, and WAN-I2V on inference.sh.

faq.question: Does it work without inference.sh?
faq.answer: No. It requires the inference.sh CLI and an authenticated account.

faq.question: Can it animate an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes image-to-video examples for P-Video and WAN-I2V.

faq.question: Can it use audio?
faq.answer: Yes. The P-Video example includes an audio URL input for synchronized video generation.

faq.question: Will it cost money to run?
faq.answer: It may use inference.sh credits or paid usage, depending on the selected model and settings.

faq.question: Is user media processed locally?
faq.answer: No. Prompts and media references are sent to the remote inference.sh service.
